title: Maximum XOR of Two Numbers in an Array
description:
Given an integer array `nums`, return the maximum result of `nums[i] XOR nums[j]`, where `0 <= i <= j < nums.length`.

Note that `i` and `j` may be equal (in which case `nums[i] XOR nums[i] = 0`).
hints: To maximize the XOR of two numbers, you want their binary representations to differ in the highest possible bit positions.
Insert the 31-bit binary representation of each number (from bit 30 down to bit 0) into a binary trie.
For each number, traverse the trie from the most significant bit to the least significant bit, greedily choosing the opposite bit branch whenever it exists.

examples.explanation: The maximum XOR is achieved by 5 XOR 25 = 28.
The maximum XOR is achieved by 91 XOR 36 = 127 (1011011 XOR 0100100 = 1111111 in binary).
